items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: I knew his father was a bass player. They called him One Eye Babe

ctx.x: Could Clayborne Williams' band fake it all then?

Well they could, but he stuck most of the music. They always did, stuck most of the music. Like I said, the band on the Pelican, we had music, but we had head numbers we did and everything, yeah. Now, and we'll get back to the same thing on the Pelican. And those three and four piece bands they used to have up there. I remember there was a band that used to come up there, there was a guy named One Eye Babe who played bass and that was Gashun's father. And they had what they used to call them, when the band could…
Now Gashun, is that Joe Phillips?
